notes:
Top-line: AtlasRelay is a large BPO + CX platform that runs multilingual contact centers across NA, LatAm and EU. Primary need: automated agent assist + real-time translation and tone adaptation so agents in Manila/Guatemala can respond in en/es/pt/fr with locale-appropriate phrasing.

Key constraints:
- Peak volume: 12k concurrent chat sessions across channels; agent-assist calls approx 2.5k qps at spikes. Need predictable tail latency (<250ms p95 for short-turn assists).
- Data controls: PII redaction in transcripts, retention 90 days default, must support EU residency for EU customers.
- Integrations: Genesys cloud + Zendesk (existing), webhooks for tool-calling (CRM updates, automated ticket tagging).
- Model preferences: prefer open-model variants for on-prem hosting; fallback stack: small quantized model for high-throughput spikes, mid-sized better-quality for standard traffic. Embeddings used for routing + knowledge retrieval in multiple languages.

Customer quotes/notes from calls:
- "We need tone that reads empathetic in LATAM Spanish, not literal translation."
- "Downtime during Black Friday-style weeks is not acceptable — need graceful degradation policy and multi-region failover."

POC plan (3 weeks):
- Week 1: integrate Redwood Dedicated edge + VPC peering, baseline latency tests with 2000 simulated agents.
- Week 2: implement locale-aware prompt templates and translation pipeline; evaluate summary quality on live tickets.
- Week 3: spike tests (12k concurrent), failover to quantized fallback; run security checklist with infra team.

Security review status: initial questionnaire submitted 2026-02-20. Legal asked for updated data residency language; security wants KMS integration and audit log retention proof.
